items.value: Authentic aging skin characteristics: fine crow's feet radiating from outer eye corners with asymmetric depth, nasolabial folds with natural shadow gradation, forehead lines varying in depth — some deep-set permanent, others faint dynamic lines. Subtle loss of volume in temples and under-eye hollows with visible orbital fat redistribution. Skin shows mixed texture: smoother on cheekbones, crepey under eyes, slightly rougher on jaw. Age spots and solar lentigines in sun-exposed areas — irregular in shape and color, not uniform dots. Visible capillary networks on nose and cheek areas. Slight skin laxity at jawline with micro-sagging. Pore size variation — enlarged on nose, finer on forehead. Thinning skin revealing underlying vein color on temples and hands. Natural hair graying with inconsistent salt-and-pepper distribution.

Overcast daylight, large diffused sky acting as enormous softbox. 5500K neutral color temperature. Extremely soft shadows with gradual falloff. Light wraps evenly around all facial contours. Subtle downward directionality from overhead sky creating faint under-chin shadow and gentle eye socket shading. Skin reads with full tonal range and natural color accuracy. No harsh highlights, no specular hotspots. Ideal for revealing skin texture without masking in shadow.

Single hard light source 45° camera-right and slightly above eye level. Creates signature Rembrandt triangle of light on shadow-side cheek. Deep defined shadows on opposite side of face with minimal fill — shadow side at 3-4 stops under key. Nose shadow connects to cheek shadow. Strong jawline definition. Specular highlight on tip of nose, forehead, and cheekbone ridge. Background falls to near-black. Warm tungsten tone 3000K optional. Painterly chiaroscuro mood.

Ultra-realistic close-up of Editorial 3x3 photo grid in a clean soft beige studio. Character (matches reference 100%) wearing (knolling board ref). Lighting: large diffused key light directly front-right, silver reflector left, subtle rim from top. Shots to include: 1. extreme close-up of lips + cheekbone with blurred hand partially covering (85mm, f/1.8, razor-thin DOF); 2. tight crop on eyes looking into lens with reflection of light strip visible (85mm, f/2.0); 3. black & white close portrait resting chin on fist, face filling frame (50mm, f/2.2); 4. over-shoulder shot, blurred foreground fabric curtain framing half face (85mm, f/2.0); 5. very close frontal with hands overlapping face, light streak across eyes (50mm, f/2.5); 6. tight angled portrait showing hair falling into eyes, soft-focus background (85mm, f/2.2); 7. crop of hands touching jawline, eyes cropped out (50mm, f/3.2, detail-focused); 8. half-body seated sideways on low cube, head turned sharply away, blurred foreground (35mm, f/4.5); 9. intense close-up of profile with single tear-like water droplet, cinematic light slice across (85mm, f/1.9). Angles: mostly tight headshots with slight high/low tilts, maintaining variation. Capture RAW, professional muted grade, smooth tonal contrast, subtle cinematic grain. Mood: intimate, introspective, character-led editorial minimalism with delicate use of fabric as prop.

Negatives: extra fingers, fused fingers, missing fingers, wrong number of fingers, distorted knuckles, impossibly long fingers, webbed fingers, boneless-looking hands, fingernails on wrong side, floating hands, hands merging into objects, wrong thumb direction, mirrored hands, baby-sized hands on adult body.

Negatives: AI glow, plastic skin, porcelain-doll finish, airbrushed texture, beauty-filter smoothing, uniform skin tone, symmetrical blemish placement, synthetic subsurface scattering, wax-figure sheen, uncanny valley skin, overly uniform pore pattern, CG skin shader, foundation-covered look.

Hyper-realistic painted plastic figurine surface: visible brush stroke direction in hand-painted areas, spray-coat smoothness on base layers with orange-peel micro-texture at close range. Paint accumulation in recessed details — eye sockets, nostrils, between fingers. Dry-brush highlighting on raised edges with slightly chalky finish. Subtle paint layer thickness visible at sharp edges where primer peeks through. Mold seam lines partially sanded but faintly visible along bilateral symmetry axis. Injection molding gate mark on hidden surface. Gloss variation between different paint types — matte skin, semi-gloss clothing, high-gloss eyes. Micro air bubbles in clear-coat. Slight color bleed where masked areas meet. Fingerprint in varnish layer. Scale-appropriate: pores and fine lines are sculpted, not real — visible tool marks. Eyes are decals or printed with slight registration offset. Plastic material reads through at thin unpainted edges.

Hyper-realistic wax figure surface: characteristic waxy translucency with subsurface light diffusion giving skin an uncanny inner glow. Surface is ultra-smooth but not plastic — retains very subtle hand-sculpted tool marks at close inspection. Specular response is soft and broad, not sharp like plastic or latex. Slight color banding where pigment layers were built up — pinkish undertones visible at thin areas like nostrils and ear edges. Micro-cracks and hairline fissures in areas of thermal stress. Glass eyes with too-perfect iris detail and slightly mismatched specular highlights compared to skin. Hair insertion points visible where individual strands or clusters meet the wax scalp. Subtle dust accumulation in recessed areas. Temperature-affected surface — minor softening and fingerprint impressions near heat sources. Gravity effects: very slight droop or sag in unsupported thin areas over time.

Negatives: flat uniform lighting, multiple conflicting shadow directions, shadowless face, ambient occlusion artifacts, halo glow around subject, light source inside body, inconsistent specular highlights, bloom on skin, HDR tonemapping artifacts, over-processed look, nuclear-white highlights with zero gradation.

Hyper-realistic latex material surface: smooth with micro-ripple distortions where stretched over contours. High specular reflection with sharp glossy highlights following light source direction. Surface tension visible at seams and edges where material meets skin — slight bunching, micro-wrinkles at flex points. Color is deep saturated with characteristic latex translucency — underlying surface faintly visible at thin-stretched areas. Fingerprint smudges and contact marks disrupting perfect gloss. Powder residue traces in creased areas. Material responds to body heat with subtle condensation at contact zones. Realistic rubber thickness variation — thinner at stretched peaks, thicker in valleys. Edge curl where material terminates. No matte zones on glossy latex, no CG-perfect uniformity.

Dual-source split lighting: saturated cyan/teal gel from camera-left, magenta/pink gel from camera-right. Each source at 90° creating hard split down center of face. Gel colors mix to near-white on nose bridge where both sources overlap. Deep color saturation in shadows — no neutral zones. Specular highlights take on gel color. Rim light or hair light optional in opposing gel color. Black negative-fill behind subject. Futuristic editorial mood, high color contrast.

skin has pores, fine lines, peach fuzz, slight imperfections, oil variation. Authentic human subsurface scattering. authentic human color complexity. real skin stretches, compressions, and shows micro-movements. avoid oversimplified subsurface scattering (skin looks too plastic or waxy), overly uniform texture (too smooth or too uniformly bumpy), incorrect specular response (too shiny everywhere or not shiny enough), lack of fine vascular detail, and missing the subtle translucency at edges like ears or nostrils.

Ultra-realistic close-up of masculine hands holding a smartphone. Natural skin texture, visible veins, tendons, and fine wrinkles. Short trimmed nails with natural nail bed texture, slight cuticle roughness. Soft natural light, realistic proportions, shallow depth of field. Photorealistic hand anatomy, high detail macro shot.

Skin exhibits authentic acne presentation: mix of active inflamed papules with reddish-pink raised areas, closed comedones as small flesh-colored bumps under the surface, scattered blackheads in T-zone areas, occasional cystic nodule with deep redness and slight swelling. Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation marks in various stages of healing — some dark brown, some fading pink. No two blemishes identical in size, shape, or color. Acne distribution follows realistic sebaceous gland density patterns — concentrated on cheeks, chin, forehead, sparse near eyes. Surrounding skin shows normal texture between breakouts. Subtle shine variation where oily zones meet dry patches. No symmetrical or pattern-based placement. No airbrushed halo around blemishes.
